title: Fennec Shand
description: As an elite mercenary and a crack shot of an assassin, Fennec Shand's skills were in high demand to clients across the underworld. She was described by those who worked with her as clever, capable, cunning, and always full of surprises. Those who underestimated her did so at their peril. She clashed with the Mandalorian once while going after a score and ended up left for dead in the Tatooine desert. Boba Fett found her and brought her to be healed by the mysterious Modifier.
